responsibility: Declares x86 backend feature-support classes and interfaces beyond basic code generation. It defines the xlogue stub enums and xlogue_layout class used for out-of-line save/restore stubs, the scalar_chain conversion framework used by x86 RTL optimizations, and prototypes for save-register decisions, function multiversioning priority and dispatcher generation, and related feature-management helpers implemented in i386-features.cc.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-features.cc, which contains the executable feature-support logic, this header defines the exposed enums, classes, and prototypes for that machinery, such as xlogue_layout and scalar_chain-related interfaces.
